reader.requirement: At --std 85, in PERFORM formats 3 and 4 (out-of-line, THRU range, in-line, VARYING with or without AFTER phrases), when neither TEST BEFORE nor TEST AFTER is written the compiler must evaluate the UNTIL condition(s) before each execution of the specified set (GR10c/GR10d 1), so a condition true at entry executes the set zero times.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.PerformVaryingInitInnerBeforeAugmentOuter: at 1985 the outer variable is augmented before the inner one is reset (GR10d 1); the TEST BEFORE default itself (TestAfter = TEST and AFTER tokens present) is edition-free

reader.edition-search: grep TestAfter over src (BoundTree, ControlFlowEmitter only); grep perform in Validation/VersionConformancePass*.cs; no TEST-phrase gate exists, the default is the absence of the TEST AFTER token at every edition
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the default is TEST BEFORE at every edition; only the nested-VARYING augment/reset order (a separate GR) differs at 1985
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers in-line UNTIL, out-of-line UNTIL and single-level VARYING; not exercised: THRU range with UNTIL, VARYING with AFTER phrases, index-name VARYING, TEST without WITH, subscripted condition re-evaluated

reader.notes: The bound PerformUntil/PerformVarying carry TestAfter = (TEST and AFTER tokens written); absent, the emitter opens a test-before while loop for every format and level. All 85 probes match the 1985 GR10c/GR10d text including the 1985 augment-outer-first order. The diagnostics at --std 85 cite §2023 clauses, which is cosmetic for this rule.

refuter.evidence: refute-1985-159/pf1.cob at --std 85 (runs/pf1-001) printed DEP C=06 I=04 J=04; THREE C=08 I=03 J=01 K=01; BYCHG C=03 I=10 B=3; FROMCHG C=04 I=03 J=03; C1TRUE I=07 J=09; EXPL C=06 I=04 J=04; INL C=00; INLV C=00 I=05 -- every value is the implied-TEST-BEFORE result of GR10d 1 (AFTER J FROM I: augment I then reset J to the new I gives 3+2+1=6; body changing BY and FROM variables taken into account; condition-1 true at entry leaves I and J at their FROM values; omitted TEST equals explicit WITH TEST BEFORE). pf2.cob (in-line VARYING with AFTER, a 2002 form) refused COBOL0900 at --std 85 (runs/pf2-001).
